tip: People gather under one roof to meet.
similar: 今 (now) has the same roof, but only a small hook underneath.

tip: Fresh young growth (生) above the moon (月). 青 covers blue and green, like new leaves.
The top is 土 earth and the bottom is a squashed 火 fire: the earth glowing red.
Sun and moon side by side: as bright as it gets.
similar: 朝 (morning) also has 月 on the right, with 十日十 on the left.

tip: Grain turns fiery gold at harvest: autumn.
Hands lift the bar across the gate, and it opens.
similar: 聞 (to hear) is the same gate with 耳 ear inside.

tip: A mark sitting above the line: up.
similar: 下 (down) is its mirror, with the mark below the line.

tip: The sun comes up through the grass while the moon is still out: morning.
similar: 明 (bright) has 日 and 月 side by side.

tip: You'll mostly meet it as the polite お/ご prefix, as in 朝御飯 (breakfast).
similar: 後 (after) also starts with 彳.

tip: The food radical on the left says it's something to eat. 反 gives the sound はん.
similar: 飴 (candy) and 館 (hall) also have 飠 food on the left.

tip: A kneecap above a foot planted on the ground.
A picture of the sun. A day is one sun.
similar: 目 (eye) is taller, with two lines inside instead of one.

tip: A child (子) runs off down the road (辶) waving a flag: out to play.
similar: 族 (tribe) has the same flag shape, without the road.

tip: The sun (日) on the left brings warmth.
similar: 暗 (dark) also has 日 on the left, with 音 sound on the right.

tip: 頁 on the right is the radical for heads. Picture a bean-shaped (豆) head.
Stand (立) by a tree (木) and cut it with an axe (斤): fresh new wood.
The sun (日) beating down on a person (者): hot weather.
similar: 熱 (hot to touch) and 厚 (thick) are also read あつい. Only 暑 has the sun on top.

tip: Fire (灬) along the bottom: hot to the touch.
similar: 暑 (hot weather) has the sun on top instead. 勢 (force) has the same top with 力 power below.

tip: Layer on layer piled under a cliff (厂): thick.
Walking (彳) with your feet tied by thread (幺): you fall behind.
similar: 御 also starts with 彳.

tip: A big mouth on legs: the older brother who does all the talking.
A woman (女) old enough to go to the market (市) alone: older sister.
similar: 妹 (younger sister) has 未 "not yet" on the right instead.

tip: Someone on the cliff top, someone crouching below it: danger.
similar: 色 (colour) has the same bent shape on top.

tip: A mouth holding a sweet on the tongue (the line inside).
Raindrops falling under the sky.
similar: It sits on top of 雲 (cloud), which you'll find in 曇 (cloudy).

tip: Food (飠) set out on a stand (台): candy.
similar: 飯 (meal) and 館 (hall) also have 飠 food on the left.

tip: Water (氵) first (先): you wash before anything else.
similar: 氵 on the left means water, as in 池, 海, 酒 and 泳.

tip: One foot (止), then a little (少) further: walking.
Lines of speech coming out of a mouth (口).
similar: On the left side of another kanji it shrinks to 訁, as in 語.

tip: A pig (豕) under a roof (宀): a farmhouse home.
similar: 字 (character) and 室 (room) also have the 宀 roof.

tip: A crossroads seen from above: go.
Water (氵) collected in one spot: a pond.
An arrow (矢) stuck in a box (匚): call the doctor.
Someone who does something: 医者 is a "medicine person".
similar: It's the bottom half of 暑 (hot weather).

tip: When you're busy, your heart (忄) gets lost (亡).
疒 is the sickness radical: something hurts.
One stroke for one.
Like a 5 with a lid on top.
Threads (糸) tying people (者) together, as in 一緒 (together).
similar: 終, 紙 and 絵 also have 糸 thread on the left.

tip: A big (大) animal with a dot for its ear: dog.
similar: 大 (big) has no dot.

tip: Under the roof, right at this moment: now.
similar: 会 (to meet) has the same roof, with 二 and 厶 underneath.

tip: The sound (音) of your heart (心): what you mean.
similar: 音 (sound) is its top half. 暗 (dark) contains 音 too.

tip: A mouth (口) tasting something that's not yet (未) ready.
similar: 妹 (younger sister) has the same 未, with 女 woman.

tip: A woman (女) who's not yet (未) grown up: younger sister.
similar: 姉 (older sister) has 市 market instead. 味 (taste) has 口 instead of 女.

tip: A woman (女) made to combine (兼) two jobs: she hates it.
An arrow pointing in: enter.
similar: 人 (person) is the reverse: in 人 the left stroke is the long one.

tip: A picture of an open mouth.
similar: The bigger box 囗 wraps around other parts, as in 国 (country).

tip: A body (尸) that's sat there a long time (古): staying, living.
Something important resting on a woman (女): what's needed.
A person bending over (勹) a coiled snake (巴), admiring its colours.
similar: 危 (dangerous) has the same bent shape on top.

tip: Grass (艹) spread over water (氵): a thin layer.
similar: 薬 (medicine) also has 艹 on top.

tip: 欠 is a person with an open mouth. 可可 is the "la-la" being sung.
A plant pushing up out of the ground: life, birth.
similar: 青 (blue) starts with a squashed form of it.

tip: Water (氵) everywhere (毎): the sea.
similar: 毎 looks like 母 (mother) wearing a hat.

tip: A samurai (士) on his legs (儿), holding out goods to sell.
similar: 買 (to buy) has 貝 money at the bottom: you need money to buy.

tip: Fire (火) next to the head radical (頁): fuming, annoyed.
Wool from a sheep (羊) right before your eyes (目): put it on.
Threads (糸) meeting (会) in embroidery: a picture.
similar: 画 also means picture.

tip: Light (日) in the centre (央) of the screen, as in 映画 (movie).
similar: 英 (English) also has 央.

tip: A field (田) drawn inside a frame: a picture.
An official (官) building that serves food (飠): a big hall.
similar: 官 (official) is its right half. 飯 and 飴 also have 飠.

tip: A flower (艹) in the centre (央): England's rose.
similar: 映 also has 央.

tip: Words (訁) from five (五) mouths (口): a language.
similar: 訁 is 言 (to say) squashed onto the left.

tip: Horse (馬) on the left: stations were once where you changed horses.
金 on the left marks a metal. 鉛筆 (pencil) is literally "lead brush".
similar: 銀 (silver) also has 金 on the left.

tip: A brush (聿) with a bamboo (⺮) handle.
similar: 書 (to write) has the same 聿 brush. 符 also has ⺮ bamboo.

tip: Evening after evening: many.
similar: 外 (outside) has a single 夕.

tip: A person stretching their arms out wide: big.
similar: 犬 (dog) adds a dot. 人 (person) has no crossbar.

tip: 力 strength at the bottom, as in 大勢 (a great crowd of people).
similar: 熱 (heat) has the same top, with 灬 fire below.

tip: A woman with two dots inside: mother.
similar: 毎 (in 海, sea) looks like 母 with a hat.

tip: Plants (艹) and fruit (果) cooked into sweets.
similar: 果 (fruit) is its bottom half.

tip: A baby with its arms out and legs wrapped up.
similar: 字 (character) is 子 under a roof.

tip: Two nuggets buried in the earth (土) under a roof: gold.
similar: On the left of another kanji it marks a metal, as in 銀 and 鉛.

tip: You (己) start running (走): you're up.
Put things down straight (直) under the net (罒).
similar: 買 (to buy) also has 罒 on top.

tip: Rice (米) stored deep inside the house: the inner part. 奥さん is the wife.
Liquid (氵) in a jar (酉).
A picture of a dish on a stand.
An altar (礻) with a stacked memorial tablet (且): honouring ancestors.
similar: 社 (shrine) also has 礻 altar.

tip: Two crossed strokes, like a father's hand holding a tool.
A child (子) under a teacher holding a stick (攵): teaching.
The white-haired (白) person (亻): the elder uncle in 伯父.
similar: 叔 is the younger uncle, as in 叔父.

tip: The one with 小 small in it is the younger uncle (叔父).
similar: 伯 is the elder uncle (伯父).

tip: A hand (扌) pressing down hard: push.
A heavy rhino (犀) plodding down the road (辶): slow, late.
similar: 遊 and 返 also have the 辶 road.

tip: A person (人) between the leaves (艹) and the tree (木), picking tea.
A hand with its fingers spread.
similar: On the left of another kanji it shrinks to 扌, as in 押.

tip: A cord wound round a stick, turn by turn: next in line, the younger brother.
Power (力) in the field (田): man.
The day (日) that's suddenly gone: 昨日 (yesterday).
A farmer carrying a sheaf of grain: one harvest a year.
Two legs walking.
similar: 入 (to enter) is the reverse: in 入 the right stroke is the long one.

tip: One (一) mouth (口) under one cover: all the same.
Wind fills the sail (几) and carries an insect (虫) along.
Two vertebrae stacked: a spine. You'll mostly see it in お風呂 (bath).
Two hands (廾) holding something private (厶): your own お弁当 (lunch box).
A hand (彐) hits the target and sparks fly (⺌): right on.
You see (見) a flash of light (⺍): you wake up and remember.
similar: 学 (to study) has the same top: study, then remember.

tip: A person straining under a heavy load.
similar: 車 (car) lacks the slanting stroke on top and the extra base line.

tip: In the water (氵) forever (永): swimming.
Feet (夂) going down a hill (阝): descending.
similar: 階 (floor) has the same 阝 hill on the left.

tip: The thread (糸) runs out in winter (冬), at the end of the year.
similar: 紙, 絵 and 緒 also have 糸 thread on the left.

tip: Stand (立) up and speak (日): sound.
similar: 意 (idea) and 暗 (dark) both contain 音.

tip: A drum (白) on a wooden (木) stand: music, fun.
similar: 薬 (medicine) is 楽 with 艹 plants on top.

tip: A woman kneeling gracefully.
similar: It's on the left of 姉, 妹 and 嫌.

tip: Fortune-telling (卜) in the evening (夕) was done outside.
similar: 多 (many) is two 夕.

tip: The king's jewel (玉) inside the borders (囗): a country.
An altar (礻) on the earth (土): a shrine where people gather, and later a company.
similar: 祖 (ancestor) also has 礻.

accept: counter for storeys of a building
tip: Everyone (皆) climbing the hill (阝): the floors of a building.
similar: 降 (descend) has the same 阝 hill.

tip: Steps cut with a tool (殳). With 階 it makes 階段 (stairs).
Shells (貝) were money. Catch them in a net (罒) and go buying.
similar: 売 (to sell) has no money in it. 貸 (to lend) has 貝 at the bottom too.

tip: A cow (牛) was the thing worth owning.
Turn back (反) along the road (辶): return something.
similar: 飯 (meal) has the same 反.

tip: Return home and pick up the broom (帚).
A brush (聿) above a speaking mouth (日): writing the words down.
similar: 筆 (writing brush) has the same 聿.

tip: A child (子) under a roof with sparks of ideas (⺍): studying.
similar: 字 (character) has a plain 宀 roof. 覚 (remember) has the same top.

tip: Four people (人) huddled under an umbrella.
Money (貝) handed over in place of (代) something: lending.
similar: 借 (to borrow) has 亻 person on the left instead.

tip: Fangs (牙) in the village (阝): wicked. In 風邪 (a cold) it's an evil wind.
People under one flag (方), armed with arrows (矢): a tribe or family.
similar: 遊 (to play) has the same flag shape.

tip: A signpost pointing a direction. Politely, あの方 means "that person".
A wooden (木) building where people mix (交): school.
The open court (廷) under the eaves (广): a garden.
similar: 店 (shop) also has 广.

tip: An animal's horn with ridges. Horns come to a point, like corners.
Plants (艹) that change (化) from bud to flower.
similar: 靴 (shoes) also has 化.

tip: 瓦 on the right means pottery: a pottery bottle or jar.
Paper was first made from fibres (糸).
similar: 終, 絵 and 緒 also have 糸 thread on the left.

tip: Flames rising from a fire.
similar: At the bottom of a kanji it becomes 灬, as in 熱 and 黒.

tip: A crowded kanji you'll only see in weekday names, like 火曜日 (Tuesday).
A sharp needle: stinging, like spicy food.
A person's (亻) origin (本): the body.
similar: 休 (rest), not on your list, is 亻 + 木 without the extra line.

tip: A person (亻) who borrowed something long ago (昔) and still has it.
similar: 貸 (to lend) has 貝 money at the bottom instead.

tip: 車 on the left: a light cart that's easy to pull.
Three lines of flowing water.
similar: 河 is also a river, written with 氵 water.

tip: Water (氵) that can (可) carry boats: a big river.
similar: 川 is the simpler river kanji.

tip: Named after the Han river and dynasty. 漢字 means "Chinese characters".
A child (子) at home (宀) learning to write characters.
similar: 学 (to study) has ⺍ sparks over the roof.

tip: A tree with branches and roots.
similar: 未 (not yet), in 妹 and 味, has an extra short line.

tip: A field (田) of ripe grain: yellow.
Water (氵) puts the fire out: it disappears.
An ear (耳) pressed to the gate (門): listening.
similar: 開 (to open) is the same gate with a bar and two hands inside.

tip: Two people sitting back to back, turning away from the cold north.
Water (氵) gone bad: dirty.
A mouth (口) on the left: taking something in, as in 喫茶店 (café).
Someone sets up (占) under the eaves (广): a shop.
similar: 庭 (garden) also has 广.

tip: Seven (七) cuts with a knife (刀).
A bamboo (⺮) tag attached (付) to you: a ticket, as in 切符.
similar: 筆 also has ⺮ bamboo.

tip: A hooked stroke: nine.
similar: 力 (power), in 男 and 勢, hooks down to the left instead.

tip: A cow's head from the front, horns and all.
similar: 午 (noon), not on your list, has no stroke poking through the top.

tip: Cuts of meat with the ribs showing inside.
A hand (爫) over a child (子): feeding milk.
Where you arrive (至) under the roof (宀): a room.
similar: 家 and 字 also have the 宀 roof.

tip: Leave the earth (土) quietly (厶): gone, past. 去年 means last year.
Metal (金) on the left. A 銀行 (bank) is literally a "silver shop".
similar: 鉛 (lead) also has 金.

tip: Plants (艹) that make you comfortable (楽): medicine.
similar: 楽 (music) is the same without 艹.

tip: Fruit (田) growing on top of a tree (木).
similar: 菓 (sweets) puts 艹 on top.

tip: Leather (革) changed (化) into shoes.
similar: 花 (flower) also has 化.

tip: A mark hanging below the line: down.
similar: 上 (up) is its mirror.

tip: The sun (日) hiding behind clouds (雲): cloudy.
The sun (日) is gone and only sounds (音) are left: dark.
similar: 暖 (warm) also has 日 on the left.

tip: A tree (木) with a crossbar and two marks: something coming.
similar: 木 (tree) is the same without the extra marks.

tip: A cart seen from above: the axle through two wheels.
similar: 重 (heavy) has an extra slanting stroke on top.

tip: Soot from the fire (灬) blackens the house: black.
similar: 熱 (heat) also has 灬 fire along the bottom.

tip: Respectful (敬) words (言) of warning: the police. 警官 is a police officer.
Under a grand roof (宀): a government official.
similar: 館 (hall) adds 飠 food on the left.
